counter.evidence: count_bytes accesses v[0] without checking list length; get_var_bytes also rejects a zero-length str or bytes; it adds len(k) for every key.

unmask.evidence: dead_nids = sampled_node_ids - active_nids; outgoing unmask ConfigRecord includes list(neighbours & dead_nids).

metric.evidence: MetricRecord.count_bytes uses 8*len(v) for lists and is not affected by this indexing error.
